_about: The Tripo models the set uses, by stand-in. The .glb files are raw inputs and stay out of the repo;
pass their folder with --objects. Each is brought to the real size in cafe_layout.json 'sizes'.
Retopologised versions only (Tripo Smart Mesh): the full-detail ones are 0.8 million triangles and more.

table._note: Four legs, as approved. Its legs came out yellow-brown; below the top they are repainted the dark blue-green iron of the master image (iron_below = share of the height, as made).
